provenance.prompt:
A full-bleed painted scene of a room or workspace, not a still life, and not a screenshot. The painting is cropped hard edge to edge by the frame: no torn or deckled paper edge, no white margin, no vignette, no border, no picture frame. Three depth planes: painted foreground props, a midground bench or table, and an architectural background with a window, door or opening, paler in the distance. Do not paint the words of this instruction anywhere: there is no title, no caption, no heading and no label in the image.

Subject: a clean laboratory bench seen straight on, glassware receding to the right. BACKGROUND: a warm cream tiled wall, a plain shelf of glassware and a wide window at the left onto soft daylight; nothing hangs on the wall. MIDGROUND: the bench with a row of plain glass beakers, flasks and a graduated cylinder whose markings are completely absent, a rack of plain test tubes with blank bodies, and a folded cloth. FOREGROUND: the bench edge running off the bottom edge, a plain wash bottle, a pair of safety goggles with clear untinted lenses and a blank lab notebook.

Composition: a clean bench with glassware receding right; the left half stays empty for the headline and hazard copy.

Grammar motifs: glassware, lab notebook, station markers, safety goggles, wash bottle.

The upper third of the frame is a quiet field reserved for a headline typeset later: a plain painted surface with a couple of faint broad brush marks, low contrast, no small detail, reaching the top edge of the frame, still painted environment and not bare parchment.

Painted in opaque gouache on warm paper, dark warm-brown ink contour drawn last, thick body colour, visible flat brush-shaped marks in every mass, crisp brush-stopped edges, one soft key light from the upper left, one shade plane down-right in a darker tint of the same pigment. Never pure black, no gradient, no glow, no bloom, no vignette.

Warm pigments only, at most 5: warm paper, dark brown ink, field green, lamp, ochre. No blue, no grey, no neutral black, no steel, no chrome, no concrete.

Orientation art only. No label on any bottle, jar, beaker or tube, no hazard diamond, no GHS pictogram, no warning sign, no equation, no formula, no measurement marking, no graduation, no meniscus reading, no procedure, no dose. Nothing in the plate is a safety reference, a chemical identity or a measurement.

Textless: no letters, words, numbers, labels, signage, notice board, wall chart, poster, chalkboard, framed picture, watermark, logo or UI chrome. Every page, chart, card, book, ledger and sheet is plain blank cream paper: no ruled lines, no grid, no drawn diagram, no scribble, no writing, no printed mark. Every tool, instrument, tin, jar and badge is plain and unengraved: no stamped letters, no maker's mark, no etched numbering, no dial face. No people, hands, faces, animals or fox.
